text: Alex K: Quick design review — compact 'create dataset' form. Proposal: keep the compact layout but avoid showing inline validation until a field is blurred or the user tries to submit. When submit fails, show a 1-line top summary + focus first error. Aim: reduce early noise on short forms. Thoughts? Maria P: lean into progressive disclosure but big a11y nit: an asterisk alone is not enough. Screen readers need explicit text and inputs should have aria-required. On mobile the asterisk can be too subtle, so we should show 'Required' in the label for small screens. Samir R: Agree on progressive errors. One concern: if we hide inline errors until blur, users might type bad values and submit — summary has to be clear and focus management solid. Also we need decision for destructive actions in the same flow (delete dataset). Do we want typed-confirm for permanents or a less heavy inline confirm? Alex K: Good call. Proposal update: 1) Inline errors shown on blur + on change after first blur (so they don’t pop immediately). 2) On submit with errors show compact top banner: "Please fix 3 errors" and autofocus first invalid field. 3) For destructive: permanent delete = typed-confirm (dataset name) + warning copy; soft-delete = inline snackbar with undo. Maria P: microcopy suggestions: - top banner: "We couldn't save — please fix the highlighted fields." - typed confirm prompt: "Type the dataset name to permanently delete: " (clear, no passive voice) Also accessibility: example for labels — use both visual asterisk and sr-only text. Samir R: code sample for aria: ```html ``` That covers screen readers and keeps visual compactness. DesignBot: auto-linter: found 3 inputs without aria-required in the compact modal prototype. See /design/prototypes/compact-create for details. Alex K: Quick vote: thumbs up if you accept the updated pattern (blur->show, submit banner, typed confirm for perm deletes, snackbar undo for soft). Reply with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:. Maria P: :thumbsup: — small ask: add an explicit short animation on focus change to help users track the first error jump. Samir R: :thumbsup: — will add focus-smooth-scroll and aria-live region for the top banner. Alex K: Thanks — I'll update the spec and add the microcopy options + code snippets to the Figma notes. Will also add a small accessibility checklist for the modal. DesignBot: spec updated: PR #482 submitted w/ patterns and accessibility checklist.
